senses.definition: (transitive) To cause (liquid, or liquid-like substance) to flow in a stream, either out of a container or into it.
examples: to pour out sand or dust.

senses.definition: (transitive, figurative) To send out as in a stream or a flood; to cause (an emotion) to come out; to cause to escape.
examples: My teacher poured scorn on my attempts at writing.

quotes.text: How London doth pour out her citizens.

senses.definition: (transitive) To move (a drunk or unsteady person) into or out of a place or vehicle.
examples: She poured him into a taxi and handed the driver the fare.
